meta_description: iGas UK is a Gas Safe registered engineer in Sunderland. Fast boiler repairs, installations, and servicing. Call 07377 909503 for urgent help.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Same-Day Emergency Callouts
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdown at 11pm in Sunderland? We're here within the hour, any day of the week.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle every aspect of gas heating and appliance safety.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repair
services.desc: Your boiler's stopped working mid-winter. We diagnose and fix most faults the same day, with all parts guaranteed and fully tested before we leave.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Safety Checks
services.desc: Annual Gas Safety Certificates keep your boiler efficient and legal. We inspect, clean, and test every component so you can heat your home with confidence.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: Upgrading to a new condensing boiler cuts your heating bills and comes with a 10-year manufacturer warranty. We handle the entire installation, decommissioning, and paperwork.

services.title: Landlord Gas Safety Inspections
services.desc: We carry out mandatory five-yearly safety checks on rental properties and issue Gas Safety Certificates recognised by local authorities across Sunderland.

services.title: Radiator & Heating System Repairs
services.desc: Leaking radiators, cold spots, or noisy pipes? We bleed, repair, and balance your heating system to restore warmth and efficiency throughout your home.

services.title: Cooker & Appliance Safety Checks
services.desc: Gas cookers and appliances need regular inspection to prevent dangerous leaks. We test for safety and advise on repairs or replacement.

about_pullquote: I started iGas because I hated seeing people ripped off with dodgy repair quotes.
about_para_1: iGas UK was founded on a simple principle: honest, fast gas engineering at a fair price. With over 15 years' experience and more than 1,000 jobs completed across Sunderland, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, diagnosing problems properly, and finishing the work the same day whenever possible. Every engineer on our team is Gas Safe Registered and fully insured.
about_para_2: Customers call us back because we don't oversell. If a repair is simple, we say so. If a new boiler makes sense, we explain why and show you the savings. We're based locally, we answer our phones, and we take pride in leaving your home warmer and safer than we found it.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About iGas

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on Christmas Eve. Phoned iGas and they were here by 6pm same day. Mark diagnosed a faulty valve, replaced it and tested everything. Fair price, no faffing about. Lifesaver.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had my landlord certificate done. Very professional bloke, explained everything clearly, and sent the certificate by email within two hours. Will use them again when my boiler needs servicing.
reviews.author: Jennifer T.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler and was dreading being sold something I didn't need. The engineer listened, explained the options honestly, and we chose a mid-range Baxi. Installation was clean and tidy, finished in one day. Really impressed.
reviews.author: Michael L.
